input.quote: 28.1 This Agreement and each dispute arising from it are governed by the laws of the State of New York, without regard to conflict-of-law principles.
input.rationale: Section 28.1 selects New York law (and excludes the CISG), and Section 28.2 gives the state and federal courts in New York County, New York exclusive jurisdiction with irrevocable submission and a venue/forum-non-conveniens waiver. The only carve-out is a customary right to seek temporary injunctive relief elsewhere to protect confidential information or IP, which does not defeat the exclusive merits forum. No arbitration provision exists anywhere in the document, so there is no foreign seat concern. The Section 28.3 executive escalation step is a pre-filing conference that expressly does not delay urgent relief or limitations-period filings, so it does not displace the court forum. This sits at the preferred position; no redline required.

mappings.element: State and federal courts in New York County have exclusive jurisdiction over the merits, subject only to temporary injunctive relief elsewhere.
mappings.quote: The state and federal courts located in New York County, New York have exclusive jurisdiction, and each Party irrevocably submits to personal jurisdiction and waives any objection based on venue or inconvenient forum. Nothing prevents a Party from seeking temporary injunctive relief in another court with jurisdiction to protect confidential information or intellectual property.
